utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair-drive details along, and I’ll keep spreading the word with anyone who can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by later to catch up, and if Jules sends me the latest details I can help out too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — swing by later and I’ll keep an ear out for any new updates. If you want the organizers, they’re right by the community center entrance.

utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center still works for me, but I want to make sure I’ve got the gloves, basic tools, and good shoes ready. If you’re heading over, let me know and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m heading over once the schedule is set. I’ll send it as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m keeping Sunday at the community center open and I’ll wait for your schedule confirmation. I’m just checking my gloves, tools, and shoes so I’m not scrambling later.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of where the donated tools get dropped off so nothing gets lost. That way we can move through the repair drive smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. I’ll head to the front gate and keep an eye on the repair drive there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll note the gate as your spot so the drop-offs stay coordinated. If anything gets moved, I’ll keep the locations updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know — it sounds like the drive is coming together, but tools and supplies are still the big need. I can help spread the details to a few neighbors, if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would help a lot, thanks. I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know the plan as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll pass it along to a few neighbors and keep an eye out for anyone who can bring tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community center still looks like the plan. I’m pulling the repair list together now and will keep everyone updated as the details come in.

utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Rosa. Once Sam sends the details and Mina has the repair list, we’ll know exactly what to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Exactly — once Sam and Mina send everything over, I’ll sort the list by urgency and make sure we’ve got a solid supply checklist.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s still at the list right now, so I’m checking with everyone while I’m out. I’ll swing by after my errands and report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara. Keep me posted if anything changes, and I’ll wait on the list for now.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — Sunday at the community center is still the plan, right? I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the gloves, tools, and shoes sorted before people head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — Sunday at the community center still sounds right. The list’s the latest, so I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know after my errands.

utterances.text: Leo: Still waiting on the repair drive schedule, but I’ll send it as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — I’ll let you know as soon as the schedule is set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can swing by later to catch up on what’s been done for the repair drive. If Jules has the latest details, send them my way and I can help.

utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep folks posted and send over Jules’s latest if I get it. We still need Mina’s repair list, and then I’ll remind everyone to sort the last bits.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — send me Jules’s latest when you have it, and I’ll catch up later to help with the last bits.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.text: Opal: Mara’s the one keeping track of the donated tools and where they get dropped off. That should help us stay organized for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good system. With the list, clipboard, and helpers in place, we should be set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, and I’m keeping an eye on the drop-off spots too, just so nothing gets misplaced. With Leo, Faye, Jules, and Mara covered, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still at the list, right? I can send the basics to Bo if that’s still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please send the basics to Bo. I’ll pass the full details to Quinn so they can spread the word and invite the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll send the basics to Bo. And the repair drive is still at the list, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — Sunday at the community center still works. Send the time details when you can, and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep the supply list current, and I’ll send the time details if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’m keeping the repair drive on track for Sunday at the community center. I’ll sort the repair list by urgency and make a supply checklist so everyone stays in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye on the donated tools and where folks drop them off, and I can help sort the supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — your help will make this much smoother. I’ll draft the repair list and jot down who needs what, then we can match it up with the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s this Sunday at the community center, and the organizers are setting up by the entrance. If you go, bring gloves, basic tools if you’ve got them, and a good pair of shoes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great — sounds like things are really coming together. I’m glad Bo’s in, and with the clipboard, pens, and supply list covered, the front gate should be a good first focus.
